title_en: Faith Is What Holds the Community Together
body_ar:
إن ما نراه اليوم من نكبات ومصائب وذل واستضعاف لنا إنما هو من عند أنفسنا، وذلك أننا ضيعنا أسباب النصر والعز والتمكين، فابتلانا الله بضدها. فإذا أردنا أن يغير الله الحال فعلينا أن نغير ما بأنفسنا، وأن نأخذ بأسباب ذلك من تحقيق الإيمان، وتحقيق الأخوة الإيمانية، ونبذ الفرقة والخلاف؛ فإن في الجماعة قوة وعزة، وفي التفرق ضعفاً وهزيمة.
الأمر بالائتلاف والنهي عن التفرق والاختلاف:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فإن سر اتحاد المسلمين والتئامهم وعدم فرقتهم هو إيمانهم الذي يدعوهم إلى ذلك؛ فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى جعل المبدأ العقدي أساساً للعمل كله، وجعل الاتحاد والالتئام جارياً على هذا المبد إ، فقال تعالى: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى وَعِيسَى أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ [الشورى:13]...
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* What we see today of calamities and afflictions, of humiliation and of our being made weak, comes only from ourselves: we let go of the causes of victory, of honour and of established strength, and so God tried us with their opposites. If we want God to change the state we are in, we must change what is in ourselves, and must take up the causes of that — realising faith, realising the brotherhood that faith creates, and casting off division and disagreement. For in holding together there is strength and honour, and in splitting apart there is weakness and defeat.

## The command to hold together, and the prohibition of splitting apart and disagreeing

In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. I ask God's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the Day of Judgement. To proceed: the secret of the Muslims' union, of their holding together and of their not splitting apart, is their faith, which is what calls them to it. For God, glorified and exalted is He, made the principle of creed the foundation of the whole of action, and made union and holding together follow upon this principle. He, exalted is He, said: {He has laid down for you of the religion that which He enjoined upon Noah, and that which We have revealed to you, and that which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus: that you establish the religion and do not split apart over it} (Sūrat al-Shūrā 42:13) …

flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, style guide section 11. The word 'المبدإ' is served with a space inserted before its final hamzah ('المبد إ'), a transcription or encoding artefact. The same word is spelled correctly two clauses earlier in the same sentence, which settles the reading. The broken spelling is preserved in body_ar and not silently repaired; body_en renders the evident word. This looks like a corpus-wide class of defect rather than a fault in this record, and should be cleaned globally if at all.

flags.context: the site's synopsis, among the causes said to have been let go
options: being firmly set in the land
flags.note: 'التمكين' is the condition of being firmly established and able to act, a Qur'anic term. 'Empowerment' was avoided because in English it carries a modern political and therapeutic register the Arabic does not.

flags.context: the synopsis and the section heading
flags.note: The pairing 'الفرقة والخلاف' and 'التفرق والاختلاف' contrasts a split in the body of the community with a split in its opinions. 'Disagreement' is used throughout for the second so that the pair stays visible. Note that 'اختلاف' elsewhere in this corpus is the neutral and legitimate difference of the jurists; here it is plainly the blameworthy kind, and the English does not carry that judgement over to other records.

translator_notes: One of a run of fifteen records, IDs 707-721, in the written-creed section, all uploaded on 9 and 10 May 2011 within a few hours of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and the first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off on an ellipsis; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/L-* series, numbered L-26 to L-39 in the same order as the IDs. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lesson was delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart. The opening paragraph is a synopsis written by the site, about the lesson and in the third person; everything from the section heading onward is the Sheikh's own words as transcribed. Nothing in the synopsis may be quoted as his.

The source's final line, 'تحميل المادة' ('download the material'), is the label of a download link in the page furniture, not part of the text. It is recorded as source_download_link and omitted from body_ar and body_en.
Qur'anic renderings here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.
The first record of the creed run, and the only one in it whose subject is communal rather than doctrinal.
